evals.prompt: Clean this frontend. Refactor evals/files/messy-landing.jsx into a clean structure. Keep brand Acme and the core CTA intent, but fix hero clutter and pointless wrappers.
evals.expected_output: Edited landing page: first viewport is brand + one headline + one support line + CTA group + full-bleed/dominant hero (not inset card). No hero overlays, stats strip, or schedule/address clutter in the first viewport. Meaningless SectionWrapper* cards removed or flattened into separate one-function files if kept. Main landing file has only one main function. Dead/unused code removed. Brief before/after summary with file list.
assertions: Edits messy-landing.jsx (or a clear replacement of it) rather than only describing changes
First viewport keeps Acme brand as a strong signal, one primary headline, one short support line, and a CTA group
Removes hero overlay badges/chips (promo sticker, live-online callout) from on top of hero media
Removes first-viewport stats strip and office/hours/address clutter
Does not keep inset/rounded hero media card as the dominant pattern when a full-bleed or edge-to-edge hero is appropriate
Removes or collapses SectionWrapper1/SectionWrapper2-style needless card wrappers
Main landing/page component file contains only one main function (no sibling SectionWrapper* in the same file)
Removes dead/unused code (unusedFlag, deadConfig, false && legacy branch)
Removes unused imports in touched files
Does not expand scope into unrelated new features or documentation files
Ends with a short summary of what moved/merged/removed

evals.prompt: Tidy components in evals/files/messy-components.jsx — extract shared UI, drop useless wrappers and hooks, remove duplication.
evals.expected_output: One main function per file: FeaturesRow alone in its file; any FeatureItem/BoxThing extracted to its own file. WrapperA/WrapperB and FeaturesRowCopy duplication gone. Unnecessary useMemo/useCallback removed. Unused props removed. Behavior/copy preserved.
assertions: Edits messy-components.jsx (and/or splits into separate component files) rather than only describing changes
Eliminates duplicated FeaturesRow / FeaturesRowCopy (or merges into one export)
Removes WrapperA/WrapperB (or equivalent no-op wrappers)
Each remaining main component file has only one main function
Removes unnecessary useMemo/useCallback for trivial values/handlers
Removes unused imports left after dropping hooks/wrappers (e.g. useMemo, useCallback)
Removes unusedProp and duplicated body rendering
Preserves the three feature titles and bodies
Does not add README or unrelated files

evals.prompt: Refactor this page — but plan only, don't edit yet. Look at evals/files/messy-landing.jsx and tell me the map and cleanup plan.
evals.expected_output: Stops after map + plan. Lists current structure (entry, wrappers, hero issues, dead code). Proposes splits/merges/naming. Does not modify files.
assertions: Produces a structure map (entry file, wrappers, sections, dead code)
Proposes a concrete cleanup plan (splits/merges/naming or equivalent)
Calls out hero clutter and needless cards as problems
Does not modify messy-landing.jsx or write replacement implementation files
Waits for go-ahead rather than applying the refactor

evals.prompt: Tidy components in evals/files/messy-types.tsx — move all interfaces and types into ./src/types/** and update imports.
evals.expected_output: No interface/type/enum left inline in component files. Types under src/types/**. FeaturesRow and PricingCard each live in their own file with only one main function. Nested interface inside PricingCard is extracted too.
assertions: Creates one or more files under src/types/** for FeatureItem, FeaturesRowProps, FeatureTone, Price, PricingCardProps (or equivalent names)
Removes top-level and nested interface/type/enum declarations from the component file(s)
Component file(s) import types from src/types/... paths
Splits FeaturesRow and PricingCard so each main component file has only one main function
Preserves FeaturesRow and PricingCard runtime behavior and displayed copy
Does not leave types co-located beside the component as the final layout

evals.prompt: Clean CSS in evals/files/messy-styles.jsx — reusable styling must be separate shared classes, not duplicated inline styles. Follow clean-css.md.
evals.expected_output: Duplicated Save/Publish button styles become one shared class (e.g. btn-primary). Near-duplicate Docs control uses shared base + modifier or a second named class. Duplicated body text styles become a shared text class. Inline style objects removed for those repeated looks. One main function remains in the component file. Unused CSS/imports cleaned.
assertions: Reads or follows clean-css.md reusable-class guidance
Extracts repeated primary button styles into a separate shared class used by Save and Publish
Does not leave identical inline style objects duplicated on multiple elements
Extracts repeated body text styles into a shared class
Docs control uses a named class (shared base + modifier or distinct class), not a one-off anonymous inline dump of the same tokens
Component file keeps only one main function
Removes unused imports if any appear after the cleanup
